about: Suzlon Energy Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells wind turbine generators and related components in India and internationally. The company operates through the WTG, Foundry & Forging, O&M services, and Others segments. It offers onshore wind turbine generators with capacities ranging from 2 MW to 6 MW, and classic fleet turbines; and services including project development through its RE DevCo business, energy storage solutions, and renewable energy asset management.
